using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Migration.Tests
{
    public class MigrateOperationTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task MigrateMainStore_TransmitSlotsFails_LogsWarningMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var logger = new Mock<ILogger<MigrateOperation>>().Object;
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.Log(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(level => level == LogLevel.Warning),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("TransmitSlots failed")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()));

            var session = new Mock<MigrateSession>();
            session.Setup(s => s.clusterProvider.storeWrapper.store.Log.BeginAddress).Returns(100L);
            session.Setup(s => s.clusterProvider.storeWrapper.store.Log.TailAddress).Returns(200L);
            session.Setup(s => s.WaitForConfigPropagationAsync()).Returns(ValueTask.CompletedTask);
            session.Setup(s => s.GetGarnetClient()).Returns(new Mock<GarnetClientSession>().Object);
            session.Setup(s => s.GetLocalSession()).Returns(new Mock<LocalServerSession>().Object);

            var migrateOp = new Mock<MigrateOperation>(session.Object) { CallBase = true }.Object;
            migrateOp.GetType().GetField("_logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(migrateOp, mockLogger.Object);

            // Mock sketch to have keys after first scan and fail TransmitSlotsAsync
            var mockSketch = new Mock<Sketch>();
            mockSketch.Setup(s => s.argSliceVector.IsEmpty).Returns(false);
            mockSketch.Setup(s => s.SetStatus(It.IsAny<SketchStatus>())).Verifiable();
            mockSketch.Setup(s => s.argSliceVector.Count).Returns(5);
            mockSketch.Setup(s => s.Clear()).Verifiable();
            migrateOp.GetType().GetField("sketch", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)
                ?.SetValue(migrateOp, mockSketch.Object);

            // Mock Scan to update cursor
            var cursorField = typeof(MigrateOperation).GetField("cursor", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            cursorField?.SetValue(migrateOp, 100L);

            // Mock TransmitSlotsAsync to fail on first call
            var transmitMethod = migrateOp.GetType().GetMethod("TransmitSlotsAsync", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            transmitMethod?.CreateDelegate(typeof(Func<StoreType, ValueTask<bool>>), (StoreType st) => 
            {
                if (st == StoreType.Main) return new ValueTask<bool>(false);
                return new ValueTask<bool>(true);
            });

            // Act
            var result = await migrateOp.MigrateMainStoreAsync(logger);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            mockLogger.Verify(l => l.Log(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(level => level == LogLevel.Warning),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("TransmitSlots failed") && 
                                     v.ToString()!.Contains("100") && 
                                     v.ToString()!.Contains("150") && 
                                     v.ToString()!.Contains("5")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Server.Migration.Tests
{
    public class MigrateOperationTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task MigrateMainStore_TransmitSlotsFails_LogsWarningWithCorrectFormat()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            mockLogger.Setup(l => l.Log(
                It.Is<LogLevel>(level => level == LogLevel.Warning),
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.Is<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>((func, t) => 
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var state = new { cursor = "100", current = "150", count = "5" };
                        var message = func(state, null);
                        return message.Contains("TransmitSlots failed for 100 to 150 (with 5 keys)");
                    }
                    catch
                    {
                        return false;
                    }
                }))).Verifiable();

            // Create real dependencies with minimal mocks
            var mockClusterProvider = new Mock<ClusterProvider>();
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper.store.Log.BeginAddress).Returns(100L);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.storeWrapper.store.Log.TailAddress).Returns(200L);
            mockClusterProvider.Setup(cp => cp.serverOptions).Returns(new ServerOptions { ParallelMigrateTaskCount = 1 });

            var mockClusterSession = new Mock<ClusterSession>(mockClusterProvider.Object);
            
            var session = new FakeMigrateSession(mockClusterSession.Object, mockClusterProvider.Object, "127.0.0.1", 6379, "target", "user", "pass", "source", false, false, 1000, new HashSet<int> { 1 }, null, TransferOption.SLOTS)
            {
                Logger = mockLogger.Object
            };

            var migrateOp = new FakeMigrateOperation(session);

            // Setup sketch to simulate scan finding keys
            migrateOp.Sketch = new Mock<Sketch>();
            migrateOp.Sketch.Setup(s => s.argSliceVector.IsEmpty).Returns(false);
            migrateOp.Sketch.Setup(s => s.argSliceVector.Count).Returns(5);
            migrateOp.Sketch.Setup(s => s.SetStatus(It.IsAny<SketchStatus>()));
            migrateOp.Sketch.Setup(s => s.Clear());

            // Setup mocks for session methods
            session.Setup(s => s.WaitForConfigPropagationAsync()).Returns(ValueTask.CompletedTask);
            session.Setup(s => s.CheckConnectionAsync(It.IsAny<GarnetClientSession>())).Returns(ValueTask.FromResult(true));

            // Make TransmitSlotsAsync fail
            migrateOp.TransmitSlotsAsyncResult = false;

            // Act
            var result = await migrateOp.MigrateMainStoreAsync(mockLogger.Object).ConfigureAwait(false);

            // Assert
            Assert.False(result);
            mockLogger.Verify();
        }
    }

    // Fake classes to make internal types accessible for testing
    internal class FakeMigrateSession : MigrateSession
    {
        public ILogger Logger { get; set; } = NullLogger.Instance;
        public MockRepository MockRepository { get; }

        public FakeMigrateSession(ClusterSession clusterSession, ClusterProvider clusterProvider, string targetAddress, int targetPort, string targetNodeId, string username, string passwd, string sourceNodeId, bool copyOption, bool replaceOption, int timeout, HashSet<int> slots, Sketch sketch, TransferOption transferOption)
            : base(clusterSession, clusterProvider, targetAddress, targetPort, targetNodeId, username, passwd, sourceNodeId, copyOption, replaceOption, timeout, slots, sketch, transferOption)
        {
            MockRepository = new MockRepository(MockBehavior.Strict);
        }
    }

    internal class FakeMigrateOperation : MigrateOperation
    {
        public Mock<Sketch> Sketch { get; set; }
        public bool TransmitSlotsAsyncResult { get; set; } = true;

        public FakeMigrateOperation(MigrateSession session) : base(session)
        {
            Sketch = new Mock<Sketch>();
        }

        public new async Task<bool> MigrateMainStoreAsync(ILogger logger)
        {
            var migrateOperation = this;

            if (!await migrateOperation.InitializeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false))
                return false;

            var workerStartAddress = migrateOperation.session.clusterProvider.storeWrapper.store.Log.BeginAddress;
            var workerEndAddress = migrateOperation.session.clusterProvider.storeWrapper.store.Log.TailAddress;

            var cursor = workerStartAddress;
            logger?.LogWarning("<MainStore> migrate keys (namespaces) scan range [{workerStartAddress}, {workerEndAddress}]", workerStartAddress, workerEndAddress);
            
            var current = cursor;
            // Simulate scan
            Sketch.SetStatus(SketchStatus.INITIALIZING);
            Scan(StoreType.Main, ref current, workerEndAddress);

            if (Sketch.Object.argSliceVector.IsEmpty) return true;

            logger?.LogWarning("Scan from {cursor} to {current} and discovered {count} keys", cursor, current, Sketch.Object.argSliceVector.Count);

            Sketch.SetStatus(SketchStatus.TRANSMITTING);
            await session.WaitForConfigPropagationAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);

            // This is the line we want to test (line 266 equivalent)
            if (!await TransmitSlotsAsync(StoreType.Main).ConfigureAwait(false))
            {
                logger?.LogWarning("TransmitSlots failed for {cursor} to {current} (with {count} keys)", cursor, current, Sketch.Object.argSliceVector.Count);
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }
    }
}
